sentences.en: The message had been left in plain sight — pinned to the *front* of the troupe's door, on a square of bark, in handwriting none of us recognised.
It said only: 'The next word is where the wind forgets to blow.'
sentences.cn: 纸条上只写着："下一个词在风忘记吹过的地方。"

sentences.en: Silverfang crossed both arms and studied it for a long time.
sentences.cn: 银牙双臂交叉，盯着它看了很久。

law:2.en: The old stone sign read: BY *LAW* OF THE ISLAND COUNCIL, ALL WORDS FOUND HERE MUST BE LOGGED BEFORE SUNRISE. Old Helm read it twice, then pulled out his ink brush without a word. We logged every tile we carried, and the gate ahead of us swung open on its own.
law:2.cnHint: 石碑上刻着岛屿议会的____，要求所有找到的文字必须在日出前登记，老舵手照做后大门自动开启。
law:2.hook: Behind the open gate, a second sign pointed to a vault no map had ever shown.
law:2.line: 'The *law* here is simple: log your words honestly, and the island lets you pass.'

sentences.en: The old stone sign read: BY *LAW* OF THE ISLAND COUNCIL, ALL WORDS FOUND HERE MUST BE LOGGED BEFORE SUNRISE.
Old Helm read it twice, then pulled out his ink brush without a word.
sentences.cn: 老舵读了两遍，然后默默地拿出了他的毛笔。

sentences.en: We logged every tile we carried, and the gate ahead of us swung open on its own.
sentences.cn: 我们登记了所有携带的瓷砖，前面的门自己打开了。

thinking:2.en: Old Helm spread the new map fragment across the worn table and fell quiet. I watched his eyes move slowly across the faded lines. 'Good *thinking* gets us farther than any wind,' he said at last. The word on the fragment glowed once, and a new island shimmered into view at the edge of the chart.
thinking:2.cnHint: 老船长仔细研究地图碎片，说正确的____比任何风都能带我们走得更远。
thinking:2.hook: The glowing island had no name — only a question mark.
thinking:2.line: 'Good *thinking* gets us farther than any wind.'

sentences.en: Old Helm spread the new map fragment across the worn table and fell quiet.
sentences.cn: 老舵把新的地图碎片铺在那张旧桌子上，陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: I watched his eyes move slowly across the faded lines.
sentences.cn: 我看着他的目光在褪色的线条上缓缓移动。

sentences.en: 'Good *thinking* gets us farther than any wind,' he said at last.
The word on the fragment glowed once, and a new island shimmered into view at the edge of the chart.
sentences.cn: 地图碎片上的字闪了一下，图表边缘浮现出一个新的岛屿。

cover:2.en: Bell found the small box half-buried under a *cover* of dry leaves near the island's edge. Inside lay a folded map fragment, still crisp, as if someone had hidden it carefully long ago. Old Helm held it to the starlight and smiled. A new route unfolded before us like a slow, quiet breath.
cover:2.cnHint: 小铃在一层落叶的____下发现了藏有地图碎片的小盒子。
cover:2.hook: Whose careful hands had hidden it there, and why?
cover:2.line: 'There is something under this *cover* — come and look.'

sentences.en: Bell found the small box half-buried under a *cover* of dry leaves near the island's edge.
Inside lay a folded map fragment, still crisp, as if someone had hidden it carefully long ago.
sentences.cn: 里面放着一张折叠的地图碎片，还很挺括，好像是有人很久以前小心地藏在那里的。

sentences.en: Old Helm held it to the starlight and smiled.
sentences.cn: 老舵把它举向星光，笑了。

sentences.en: A new route unfolded before us like a slow, quiet breath.
sentences.cn: 一条新的航线在我们面前缓缓展开，就像一次轻轻的呼吸。

earth:2.en: The island's centre was soft with dark *earth*, unlike the pale stone we had walked for days. Bell knelt and pressed her palm flat against it. 'Things grow here,' she said quietly. Old Helm added the word to our collection, and somewhere below us the roots of the next island began to appear on the map.
earth:2.cnHint: 小岛中央有一片深色的____，小铃感觉到这里有生命存在。
earth:2.hook: Whatever grew here had been waiting a very long time.
earth:2.line: 'This *earth* is soft — something is alive beneath us.'

sentences.en: The island's centre was soft with dark *earth*, unlike the pale stone we had walked for days.
Bell knelt and pressed her palm flat against it.
sentences.cn: 小铃跪下来，把手掌紧紧贴在地上。

sentences.en: 'Things grow here,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "这里长得出东西，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Old Helm added the word to our collection, and somewhere below us the roots of the next island began to appear on the map.
sentences.cn: 老舵把这个词加进了我们的收集，我们脚下某处岛屿的根须开始在地图上显现。

paper:2.en: Tucked inside a cracked lantern near the dock, I found a roll of thin *paper* covered in careful handwriting. Each line named an island we had never heard of. Old Helm unrolled it slowly, his breath catching. 'This is older than our map,' he whispered, and Bell began to trace the new names with her finger.
paper:2.cnHint: 我在破旧灯笼里找到一卷写满岛屿名字的____，比我们的地图还古老。
paper:2.hook: One island name at the bottom had been crossed out twice.
paper:2.line: 'This *paper* is older than anything we carry — read it carefully.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside a cracked lantern near the dock, I found a roll of thin *paper* covered in careful handwriting.
Each line named an island we had never heard of.
sentences.cn: 每一行都记着我们从未听说过的岛屿。

sentences.en: Old Helm unrolled it slowly, his breath catching.
sentences.cn: 老舵慢慢地展开它，呼吸一下子卡住了。

sentences.en: 'This is older than our map,' he whispered, and Bell began to trace the new names with her finger.
sentences.cn: "这比我们的地图还要古老，"他低声说，小铃开始用手指描绘那些新的名字。

art:2.en: The cave wall was covered in painted figures — boats, stars, and creatures I could not name. 'This is *art* left by those who sailed before us,' Old Helm said softly, touching nothing. Bell found a small symbol in the corner that matched our next target word exactly. We copied it down and stepped back out into the open sky.
art:2.cnHint: 洞穴墙壁上布满壁画，老舵说这是前人留下的____，小铃从中找到了线索。
art:2.hook: The smallest figure in the painting seemed to be pointing outward.
art:2.line: 'This *art* was made by those who knew the sky better than we do.'

sentences.en: The cave wall was covered in painted figures — boats, stars, and creatures I could not name.
sentences.cn: 洞穴墙上覆满了画——船、星星，还有一些我叫不出名字的生物。

sentences.en: 'This is *art* left by those who sailed before us,' Old Helm said softly, touching nothing.
Bell found a small symbol in the corner that matched our next target word exactly.
sentences.cn: 小铃在角落里发现了一个小符号，它正好和我们下一个目标词完全一致。

sentences.en: We copied it down and stepped back out into the open sky.
sentences.cn: 我们把它抄了下来，走出洞穴回到了开阔的天空下。

street:2.en: The abandoned island had one long *street* running from shore to shore, lined with empty lantern posts. At the far end, Bell spotted a stone pillar with a map fragment sealed inside a glass box at its top. Old Helm read the fragment aloud, and the lanterns along the street lit one by one, guiding us toward the next departure point.
street:2.cnHint: 废弃小岛上有一条长____，小铃在尽头的石柱上发现了封存的地图碎片。
street:2.hook: The last lantern lit up before Old Helm even finished reading.
street:2.line: 'Follow this *street* to its end — that is where the next clue waits.'

sentences.en: The abandoned island had one long *street* running from shore to shore, lined with empty lantern posts.
At the far end, Bell spotted a stone pillar with a map fragment sealed inside a glass box at its top.
sentences.cn: 小铃在远处发现了一根石柱，顶端的玻璃盒子里封着一张地图碎片。

sentences.en: Old Helm read the fragment aloud, and the lanterns along the street lit one by one, guiding us toward the next departure point.
sentences.cn: 老舵大声读出了碎片上的内容，街道两旁的灯笼一盏接一盏地亮了起来，为我们指引着前往下一个出发点的路。

talent:2.en: Silverfang watched Bell decode the tangled symbols on the fragment in under a minute and crossed her arms slowly. 'That kind of *talent* is rare,' she said, and it sounded almost like a compliment. Bell looked up, surprised. Old Helm added the word quietly to our collection, and a distant island rose gently on the horizon.
talent:2.cnHint: 小铃飞速破解了地图符号，银牙罕见地称赞她拥有这样的____。
talent:2.hook: Silverfang turned away quickly, but I caught her small smile.
talent:2.line: 'That kind of *talent* does not come from practice alone.'

sentences.en: Silverfang watched Bell decode the tangled symbols on the fragment in under a minute and crossed her arms slowly.
sentences.cn: 银牙看着小铃在一分钟内解开了那些缠在一起的符号，慢慢地交叉起双臂。

sentences.en: 'That kind of *talent* is rare,' she said, and it sounded almost like a compliment.
Bell looked up, surprised.
sentences.cn: 小铃抬起头，惊讶地看着她。

sentences.en: Old Helm added the word quietly to our collection, and a distant island rose gently on the horizon.
sentences.cn: 老舵默默地把这个词加进了我们的收集，一个遥远的岛屿在地平线上轻轻升起。

overall:2.en: We laid all the collected fragments on the deck and stepped back to see the *overall* shape they made together. It was not just a map — it was a message, each word a piece of one long sentence written across the sky. Old Helm traced the final line with one finger. 'Now we know where we are going,' he said, and we did.
overall:2.cnHint: 将所有碎片拼在一起后，我们终于看清了____的地图形状，那是一条横跨天空的信息。
overall:2.hook: The final destination had been hidden in plain sight all along.
overall:2.line: 'The *overall* shape tells us more than any single piece could.'

sentences.en: We laid all the collected fragments on the deck and stepped back to see the *overall* shape they made together.
It was not just a map — it was a message, each word a piece of one long sentence written across the sky.
sentences.cn: 它不只是一张地图——它是一条信息，每个词都是写在天空中的一个长句子的碎片。

sentences.en: Old Helm traced the final line with one finger.
sentences.cn: 老舵用一根手指描绘了最后一行。

sentences.en: 'Now we know where we are going,' he said, and we did.
sentences.cn: "现在我们知道要去哪儿了，"他说，我们确实知道。

satisfaction:2.en: Old Helm unrolled the newest map fragment on the deck. Every island name we had found glowed faintly, like tiny lanterns. He pressed his thumb against the last blank space. 'Almost complete,' he said with quiet *satisfaction*, the kind that comes after a long and worthy journey. One gap remained.
satisfaction:2.cnHint: 老舵主展开地图，看着已填满的岛名，露出一种深深的____。
satisfaction:2.hook: But the final blank space had begun to move.
satisfaction:2.line: 'There is real *satisfaction* in knowing we found each piece ourselves.'

sentences.en: Old Helm unrolled the newest map fragment on the deck.
sentences.cn: 老舵在甲板上展开了最新的地图碎片。

sentences.en: Every island name we had found glowed faintly, like tiny lanterns.
sentences.cn: 我们找到的每个岛屿名字都隐隐发着光，像一盏盏微小的灯笼。

sentences.en: He pressed his thumb against the last blank space.
sentences.cn: 他把大拇指按在最后一个空白的地方。

sentences.en: 'Almost complete,' he said with quiet *satisfaction*, the kind that comes after a long and worthy journey.
One gap remained.
sentences.cn: 还剩一个空白。

cultivate:2.en: Bell had claimed a small patch of soil near the ship's bow, pressing seeds into the dark earth each morning. 'You can *cultivate* more than plants,' she told me, smoothing the soil with one careful hand. 'Patience grows here too.' Around us, the floating island drifted softly through pale cloud.
cultivate:2.cnHint: 小铃在船头的土地上耕作，说这里____的不只是植物。
cultivate:2.hook: Then one seedling glowed a colour no plant should be.
cultivate:2.line: 'We *cultivate* good habits the same way — slowly, every single day.'

sentences.en: Bell had claimed a small patch of soil near the ship's bow, pressing seeds into the dark earth each morning.
sentences.cn: 小铃在船头附近开辟了一小块土地，每天早上都把种子按进黑色的泥土里。

sentences.en: 'You can *cultivate* more than plants,' she told me, smoothing the soil with one careful hand.
'Patience grows here too.'
sentences.cn: 耐心也在这儿生长。

sentences.en: Around us, the floating island drifted softly through pale cloud.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，浮岛轻轻飘过淡色的云层。

productive:2.en: Silverfang spread charts across his own deck and called the morning meeting to order. In two hours we had named four islands, traced two wind routes, and found a hidden current. 'Now that,' he said, folding the last chart with a sharp snap, 'was a *productive* morning.' Old Helm simply smiled.
productive:2.cnHint: 银牙船长宣布这个上午非常____，众人都颇为满意。
productive:2.hook: Old Helm's smile, however, held a private secret.
productive:2.line: 'A *productive* crew asks questions before they sail, not after.'

sentences.en: Silverfang spread charts across his own deck and called the morning meeting to order.
sentences.cn: 银牙把海图铺满了甲板，召集大伙儿开晨会。

sentences.en: In two hours we had named four islands, traced two wind routes, and found a hidden current.
sentences.cn: 两小时内我们给四座岛屿命了名，描绘了两条风道，还发现了一股隐藏的洋流。

sentences.en: 'Now that,' he said, folding the last chart with a sharp snap, 'was a *productive* morning.'
Old Helm simply smiled.
sentences.cn: 老舵只是笑了笑。

vision:2.en: High on the observation post, Bell handed me her small brass telescope. Through it the edge of the world curved away in a bright arc. 'Good *vision* is not only about seeing far,' she said softly. 'It is about knowing what matters when you look.' A new island shimmered at the rim.
vision:2.cnHint: 小铃借给我望远镜，说真正的____不只是看得远。
vision:2.hook: The shimmering island was not on any chart.
vision:2.line: 'My *vision* for this voyage stretches far beyond that last cloud.'

sentences.en: High on the observation post, Bell handed me her small brass telescope.
sentences.cn: 在观察塔的高处，小铃把她的小黄铜望远镜递给我。

sentences.en: Through it the edge of the world curved away in a bright arc.
sentences.cn: 透过镜头，世界的边缘弯成了一道明亮的弧线。

sentences.en: 'Good *vision* is not only about seeing far,' she said softly.
'It is about knowing what matters when you look.'
sentences.cn: 那是关乎知道你看的时候什么才重要。

sentences.en: A new island shimmered at the rim.
sentences.cn: 一座新的岛屿在地平线闪闪发光。

distance:2.en: The word-fragment we needed was written on a stone marker at the far end of Driftmoss Island. Old Helm studied it from where we stood. 'See the *distance* between us and that stone,' he said. 'Every step you take teaches you something the map cannot.' We started walking in single file.
distance:2.cnHint: 老舵主指着远处的石碑，说____本身也是一种教导。
distance:2.hook: Halfway there, the stone marker quietly turned around.
distance:2.line: 'Keep the right *distance* and you see the whole picture clearly.'

sentences.en: The word-fragment we needed was written on a stone marker at the far end of Driftmoss Island.
sentences.cn: 我们需要的文字碎片写在流苔岛远端的一块石碑上。

sentences.en: Old Helm studied it from where we stood.
sentences.cn: 老舵从我们站的地方研究它。

sentences.en: 'See the *distance* between us and that stone,' he said.
'Every step you take teaches you something the map cannot.'
sentences.cn: 你走的每一步都教你地图学不到的东西。

sentences.en: We started walking in single file.
sentences.cn: 我们排成一队开始行走。

forward:2.en: The rope bridge swayed over a canyon of open sky. Silverfang tested the first plank with one boot, then looked back at us with calm eyes. 'The only safe direction here is *forward*,' he said. He stepped out, steady and unhurried, and the bridge held. One by one we followed him across.
forward:2.cnHint: 银牙船长踏上摇晃的绳桥，说此刻唯一安全的方向是____。
forward:2.hook: The bridge dissolved behind the last person to cross.
forward:2.line: 'Moving *forward* together is safer than standing still alone.'

sentences.en: The rope bridge swayed over a canyon of open sky.
sentences.cn: 绳桥在开阔的天空峡谷上摇晃。

sentences.en: Silverfang tested the first plank with one boot, then looked back at us with calm eyes.
sentences.cn: 银牙用一只靴子试探了第一块木板，然后用平静的眼神回过头看我们。

sentences.en: 'The only safe direction here is *forward*,' he said.
He stepped out, steady and unhurried, and the bridge held.
sentences.cn: 他稳步地踏出去，桥纹丝不动。

sentences.en: One by one we followed him across.
sentences.cn: 我们一个接一个跟他穿过了桥。

harmful:2.en: We found the old signal fire built of strange violet wood. Bell knelt and sniffed it carefully. 'Do not light this,' she said, standing back up. 'The smoke would be *harmful* to the root-plants that feed the whole island.' We left it cold and searched instead for a safer way to send our signal.
harmful:2.cnHint: 小铃发现那堆木柴的烟对岛上植物____，阻止了大家点火。
harmful:2.hook: Something else on the island had already been burning.
harmful:2.line: 'Hiding the truth from the crew is just as *harmful* as a wrong turn.'

sentences.en: We found the old signal fire built of strange violet wood.
sentences.cn: 我们找到了由奇异紫色木头构成的老信号火堆。

sentences.en: Bell knelt and sniffed it carefully.
sentences.cn: 小铃跪下来仔细嗅了嗅。

sentences.en: 'Do not light this,' she said, standing back up.
sentences.cn: 别点这个火，她站起身说。

sentences.en: 'The smoke would be *harmful* to the root-plants that feed the whole island.'
We left it cold and searched instead for a safer way to send our signal.
sentences.cn: 我们让火熄灭了，转而寻找一个更安全的办法来发送信号。

impossible:2.en: The final map fragment floated in mid-air above the island's centre, spinning slowly. Old Helm stared at it without blinking. 'Reaching it looks *impossible*,' I whispered. He shook his head, pulled a small folded word-token from his coat, and held it up. The fragment dropped gently into his waiting hand.
impossible:2.cnHint: 漂浮在空中的地图碎片看似____，老舵主却用一个字符将它取下。
impossible:2.hook: The word on the token was the same as our next destination.
impossible:2.line: 'Nothing is truly *impossible* if you carry the right word with you.'

sentences.en: The final map fragment floated in mid-air above the island's centre, spinning slowly.
sentences.cn: 最后的地图碎片浮在岛屿中心上方，缓缓旋转。

sentences.en: Old Helm stared at it without blinking.
sentences.cn: 老舵瞪着它，眼睛都不眨一下。

sentences.en: 'Reaching it looks *impossible*,' I whispered.
He shook his head, pulled a small folded word-token from his coat, and held it up.
sentences.cn: 他摇了摇头，从外套里掏出一个折叠好的小纸条，举了起来。

sentences.en: The fragment dropped gently into his waiting hand.
sentences.cn: 碎片温柔地掉进了他等待的手心。

meaning:2.en: Deep inside a hollow cloud-rock, I found a carved stone tablet. Strange symbols covered its face, but Old Helm traced each line with a careful finger. 'Every mark has a *meaning*,' he said softly. The symbols slowly formed a map — pointing toward an island none of us had ever seen.
meaning:2.cnHint: 老船长在石板上发现了隐藏的____，那些符号竟然拼出了一张新地图。
meaning:2.hook: The island on the map should not exist.
meaning:2.line: 'Every mark has a *meaning*, if you look long enough.'

sentences.en: Deep inside a hollow cloud-rock, I found a carved stone tablet.
sentences.cn: 在一块中空的云石深处，我找到了一块刻着花纹的石板。

sentences.en: Strange symbols covered its face, but Old Helm traced each line with a careful finger.
sentences.cn: 奇怪的符号覆盖了它的表面，老舵用小心的手指追踪着每一条线。

sentences.en: 'Every mark has a *meaning*,' he said softly.
The symbols slowly formed a map — pointing toward an island none of us had ever seen.
sentences.cn: 符号慢慢组成了一张地图——指向我们都从没见过的一座岛屿。

strengthen:2.en: The rope bridge to the next island was fraying badly. Bell pulled out a spool of silver cord from her pack and began weaving it through the old fibres. 'This will *strengthen* it enough for all of us,' she said. One by one, we crossed — the bridge holding firm under each step.
strengthen:2.cnHint: 小铃用银色细绳____了破旧的绳桥，让大家得以安全通过。
strengthen:2.hook: But something heavy was already moving on the other side.
strengthen:2.line: 'Weave it tight — *strengthen* the old with the new.'

sentences.en: The rope bridge to the next island was fraying badly.
sentences.cn: 通往下一个岛屿的绳桥磨损得很厉害。

sentences.en: Bell pulled out a spool of silver cord from her pack and began weaving it through the old fibres.
sentences.cn: 小铃从背包里掏出一卷银色绳线，开始把它编进那些老旧的纤维里。

sentences.en: 'This will *strengthen* it enough for all of us,' she said.
One by one, we crossed — the bridge holding firm under each step.
sentences.cn: 我们一个接一个穿过了桥——桥在每一步下都坚如磐石。

competitive:2.en: At the Sky Bazaar floating market, Bell spotted a rare wind-compass for sale. Silverfang appeared beside us, eyes bright. The bidding grew fast and *competitive*, each offer climbing higher than the last. In the end, Bell won — but Silverfang gave her a sharp smile, as if this were only the first round.
competitive:2.cnHint: 在天空集市上，一场____激烈的竞价让小铃和银牙之间的较量更加有趣。
competitive:2.hook: Silverfang's smile meant the real contest had just begun.
competitive:2.line: 'Keep your price ready — this crowd is *competitive*.'

sentences.en: At the Sky Bazaar floating market, Bell spotted a rare wind-compass for sale.
sentences.cn: 在空中集市的浮动商场里，小铃发现了一个罕见的风罗盘在出售。

sentences.en: Silverfang appeared beside us, eyes bright.
sentences.cn: 银牙出现在我们身边，眼睛闪闪发光。

sentences.en: The bidding grew fast and *competitive*, each offer climbing higher than the last.
In the end, Bell won — but Silverfang gave her a sharp smile, as if this were only the first round.
sentences.cn: 最后小铃赢了——但银牙给了她一个尖锐的微笑，好像这只是第一轮。

recently:2.en: Old Helm unrolled a faded chart on the deck. He pointed to a cluster of small islands near the eastern edge. 'These passages have *recently* shifted,' he told us, tracing new pencil lines over the old ink. Something — wind, or will — was rearranging the world, and our old maps were already wrong.
recently:2.cnHint: 老船长发现地图上的航道____发生了变化，旧地图已经不再准确。
recently:2.hook: Whatever moved the islands might still be moving them now.
recently:2.line: 'The eastern routes have *recently* changed — trust nothing old.'

sentences.en: Old Helm unrolled a faded chart on the deck.
sentences.cn: 老舵在甲板上展开了一张褪色的海图。

sentences.en: He pointed to a cluster of small islands near the eastern edge.
sentences.cn: 他指向东边边缘附近的一群小岛。

sentences.en: 'These passages have *recently* shifted,' he told us, tracing new pencil lines over the old ink.
Something — wind, or will — was rearranging the world, and our old maps were already wrong.
sentences.cn: 有什么东西——风，或者意志——在重新排列这个世界，我们的旧地图已经过时了。

nation:2.en: We landed on an island covered in coloured banners. An elder explained that long ago, every floating island had been part of one great *nation* — sharing words, songs, and sky-roads. Then the winds scattered them. Our troupe grew quiet, each of us feeling the weight of something once whole, now spread wide across the clouds.
nation:2.cnHint: 岛上的老人讲述了曾经统一的浮岛____，如今却四散于云端。
nation:2.hook: Somewhere, one last sky-road might still connect them all.
nation:2.line: 'We were one *nation* once — before the great wind came.'

sentences.en: We landed on an island covered in coloured banners.
sentences.cn: 我们登陆了一座布满彩色旗帜的岛屿。

sentences.en: An elder explained that long ago, every floating island had been part of one great *nation* — sharing words, songs, and sky-roads.
Then the winds scattered them.
sentences.cn: 然后风把它们吹散了。

sentences.en: Our troupe grew quiet, each of us feeling the weight of something once whole, now spread wide across the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我们的队伍都安静了下来，每个人都感受到某种曾经完整、如今却在云层里散开的东西的沉甸甸的分量。

perceive:2.en: The fog on Lantern Isle was so thick I could barely see my own hand. But Bell stood still, eyes closed. 'I can *perceive* the lighthouse,' she said quietly, 'by the warmth it puts in the air.' She turned twenty degrees left, and walked straight to it — the beam cutting through the white at last.
perceive:2.cnHint: 在浓雾中，小铃凭借感知____到了灯塔的位置，带领大家找到了方向。
perceive:2.hook: The lighthouse keeper had been waiting for exactly our troupe.
perceive:2.line: 'Close your eyes — you will *perceive* more than you expect.'

sentences.en: The fog on Lantern Isle was so thick I could barely see my own hand.
sentences.cn: 灯笼岛上的雾浓得我几乎看不见自己的手。

sentences.en: But Bell stood still, eyes closed.
sentences.cn: 但小铃站得纹丝不动，眼睛闭着。

sentences.en: 'I can *perceive* the lighthouse,' she said quietly, 'by the warmth it puts in the air.'
She turned twenty degrees left, and walked straight to it — the beam cutting through the white at last.
sentences.cn: 她向左转了二十度，笔直地走向灯塔——光束终于穿破了白茫茫的雾。

pound:2.en: In the bazaar at Copper Step Island, Old Helm traded a heavy bag of goods. The merchant weighed each item on a brass scale, calling out each *pound* in a clear, proud voice. At the final count, Old Helm received a small bronze key — the kind, the merchant whispered, that opens sky-vaults.
pound:2.cnHint: 在集市上，商人用秤称出每件货物的____，老船长换来了一把神秘的铜钥匙。
pound:2.hook: No one on this island knew what the sky-vault held.
pound:2.line: 'Every *pound* of it weighed — nothing is given free here.'

sentences.en: In the bazaar at Copper Step Island, Old Helm traded a heavy bag of goods.
sentences.cn: 在铜阶岛的集市里，老舵交易了一大袋货物。

sentences.en: The merchant weighed each item on a brass scale, calling out each *pound* in a clear, proud voice.
At the final count, Old Helm received a small bronze key — the kind, the merchant whispered, that opens sky-vaults.
sentences.cn: 最后，老舵得到了一把小青铜钥匙——商人低声说，这种钥匙能打开天空之库。

purpose:2.en: I asked Old Helm why he kept collecting words instead of treasure. He looked at the horizon for a long moment. 'Every word we find has a *purpose*,' he said, 'like a key that was made for one specific lock.' He pressed the latest word-fragment into my palm, warm as sunlight, and pointed forward.
purpose:2.cnHint: 老船长告诉我，收集每一个词语都有其特定的____，就像专为某把锁打造的钥匙。
purpose:2.hook: Far ahead, a door stood alone in the open sky.
purpose:2.line: 'Each word has a *purpose* — find the lock it fits.'

sentences.en: I asked Old Helm why he kept collecting words instead of treasure.
sentences.cn: 我问老舵为什么执意收集词语而不是宝藏。

sentences.en: He looked at the horizon for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 他看了很久的地平线。

sentences.en: 'Every word we find has a *purpose*,' he said, 'like a key that was made for one specific lock.'
He pressed the latest word-fragment into my palm, warm as sunlight, and pointed forward.
sentences.cn: 他把最新的词语碎片按进我的掌心，温热得像阳光，然后指向前方。

respond:2.en: We found a stone door carved with a single question: 'Who seeks the edge of the map?' Old Helm pressed his hand against the cold surface and waited. Slowly, a low hum filled the air. The door had chosen to *respond* — and the whole island trembled as it swung open.
respond:2.cnHint: 石门上刻着一个问题，老舵手触碰它后，门竟然____了。
respond:2.hook: Beyond the door, something was already watching us.
respond:2.line: 'The door will *respond* only to someone with a true heart,' Old Helm said quietly.

sentences.en: We found a stone door carved with a single question: 'Who seeks the edge of the map?'
sentences.cn: 我们发现了一扇石门，上面刻着一个问题："谁在寻找地图的尽头？"

sentences.en: Old Helm pressed his hand against the cold surface and waited.
sentences.cn: 老舵把手贴在冰冷的石面上，等待着。

sentences.en: Slowly, a low hum filled the air.
sentences.cn: 慢慢地，空气里响起一声低沉的嗡鸣。

sentences.en: The door had chosen to *respond* — and the whole island trembled as it swung open.

welcome:2.en: A lantern swayed above a wooden arch at the island's edge. Beneath it, Bell found a sign so old the paint had nearly faded. She traced the letters with one finger and read them aloud: 'All seekers of words are *welcome* here.' The warmth of those words made the cold wind feel much kinder.
welcome:2.cnHint: 小铃在岛屿边缘发现了一块旧牌子，上面写着寻词者都____。
welcome:2.hook: But the lantern above had not been lit from outside.
welcome:2.line: Bell smiled and said, 'I think we are *welcome* to stay a little longer.'

sentences.en: A lantern swayed above a wooden arch at the island's edge.
sentences.cn: 一盏灯笼在岛边的木拱门上摇晃。

sentences.en: Beneath it, Bell found a sign so old the paint had nearly faded.
sentences.cn: 小铃在它下面找到了一块牌子，油漆褪得几乎看不见了。

sentences.en: She traced the letters with one finger and read them aloud: 'All seekers of words are *welcome* here.'
The warmth of those words made the cold wind feel much kinder.
sentences.cn: 那些词语的温度让凛冽的风吹起来舒服多了。

appeal:2.en: The oldest resident of the island pressed a rolled-up note into my hands. It was an *appeal* — a careful, urgent plea written by a whole village asking someone to carry their last word-fragment to the map's edge before the island drifted too far. My hands would not stop trembling.
appeal:2.cnHint: 老居民交给我一封____，请求我把最后的词语碎片带到地图尽头。
appeal:2.hook: The island had already begun to drift away from the others.
appeal:2.line: Old Helm read it twice and said, 'This *appeal* deserves an answer.'

sentences.en: The oldest resident of the island pressed a rolled-up note into my hands.
sentences.cn: 岛上最年长的居民把一张卷起的纸条塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: It was an *appeal* — a careful, urgent plea written by a whole village asking someone to carry their last word-fragment to the map's edge before the island drifted too far.
My hands would not stop trembling.
sentences.cn: 我的双手一直在颤抖。

finally:2.en: We had crossed seven islands, solved riddles in the rain, and traded star-charts with strangers. Now, standing at the very edge of the last floating rock, Bell held up the assembled map and whispered a single word. The full path glowed gold. We had *finally* seen where all the fragments led.
finally:2.cnHint: 小铃将地图碎片拼合后，我们____看清了所有碎片通向的地方。
finally:2.hook: What glowed there was not a place — it was a door.
finally:2.line: 'We have *finally* made it to the edge,' Bell said, her voice full of wonder.

sentences.en: We had crossed seven islands, solved riddles in the rain, and traded star-charts with strangers.
sentences.cn: 我们穿过了七座岛屿，在雨中解过谜题，跟陌生人交换过星图。

sentences.en: Now, standing at the very edge of the last floating rock, Bell held up the assembled map and whispered a single word.
sentences.cn: 现在，站在最后那块浮石的边缘，小铃举起拼好的地图，低声说出了一个词。

sentences.en: The full path glowed gold.
sentences.cn: 整条路径闪闪发光。

sentences.en: We had *finally* seen where all the fragments led.

guess:2.en: The stone box had no lock, only a small slot carved with the outline of a single word. 'We have to *guess* which word fits,' said Old Helm, studying the shape. I looked at every fragment we had collected and held one up to the slot. It slid in perfectly, and the box opened with a sigh.
guess:2.cnHint: 石盒上没有锁，老舵手说我们必须____出哪个词语能打开它。
guess:2.hook: Inside was something none of us had expected to find.
guess:2.line: 'Can you *guess* which word the box is asking for?' Old Helm said.

sentences.en: The stone box had no lock, only a small slot carved with the outline of a single word.
sentences.cn: 石盒子没有锁，只有一条狭窄的口子，刻着一个词语的轮廓。

sentences.en: 'We have to *guess* which word fits,' said Old Helm, studying the shape.
I looked at every fragment we had collected and held one up to the slot.
sentences.cn: 我看了看我们收集的每一块碎片，举起其中一块对准口子。

sentences.en: It slid in perfectly, and the box opened with a sigh.
sentences.cn: 它完美地滑了进去，石盒子吁地一声打开了。

protection:2.en: Beneath a cracked rock pillar we found a bundle of feathers woven into a circle. Bell explained that the island's people used to hang such circles above doorways. 'It is a *protection* charm,' she said, turning it gently in the starlight. We hung it at the entrance of our camp before the night wind rose.
protection:2.cnHint: 小铃发现了一个羽毛编成的圈，说那是一种____符咒。
protection:2.hook: That night, the wind howled — but nothing crossed our doorway.
protection:2.line: 'This charm has given *protection* to many travellers before us,' Bell said.

sentences.en: Beneath a cracked rock pillar we found a bundle of feathers woven into a circle.
sentences.cn: 一根裂开的石柱下，我们找到了一束羽毛编织成的圆环。

sentences.en: Bell explained that the island's people used to hang such circles above doorways.
sentences.cn: 小铃解释说岛上的人过去常在门口上方挂这样的东西。

sentences.en: 'It is a *protection* charm,' she said, turning it gently in the starlight.
We hung it at the entrance of our camp before the night wind rose.
sentences.cn: 夜风起来之前，我们把它挂在了营地的入口。

resident:2.en: An old woman was sitting alone on the highest rock, feeding crumbs to small cloud-birds. She was the only *resident* left on this drifting island. She had stayed behind to guard a word carved into the rock's heart. When we asked to see it, she simply nodded and led us up the narrow path.
resident:2.cnHint: 这座漂移岛上只剩下一位____，她独自守护着一个刻在岩心里的词语。
resident:2.hook: The word she guarded was not what any of us had guessed.
resident:2.line: Silverfang said softly, 'Every *resident* who stayed here left something behind.'

sentences.en: An old woman was sitting alone on the highest rock, feeding crumbs to small cloud-birds.
sentences.cn: 一位老妇人独自坐在最高的岩石上，喂着小小的云雀。

sentences.en: She was the only *resident* left on this drifting island.
She had stayed behind to guard a word carved into the rock's heart.
sentences.cn: 她留下来是为了守护一个刻在岩石心脏里的词语。

sentences.en: When we asked to see it, she simply nodded and led us up the narrow path.
sentences.cn: 我们问她能不能看一眼，她只是点了点头，带我们走上了窄窄的小路。

willing:2.en: Silverfang had the fastest ship, but she asked nothing in return at first. Later, at the edge of the last island, she told Old Helm she was *willing* to carry us further only if we shared the final word with her. Old Helm looked at me, then back at her, and slowly extended his hand.
willing:2.cnHint: 竞争船长告诉老舵手，只要我们分享最后的词语，她就____带我们继续前行。
willing:2.hook: Old Helm's pause before he shook her hand told me everything.
willing:2.line: 'I am *willing* to help, but only if we go forward together,' said Silverfang.

sentences.en: Silverfang had the fastest ship, but she asked nothing in return at first.
sentences.cn: 银牙有最快的船，一开始什么都不要。

sentences.en: Later, at the edge of the last island, she told Old Helm she was *willing* to carry us further only if we shared the final word with her.
Old Helm looked at me, then back at her, and slowly extended his hand.
sentences.cn: 老舵看了看我，又看了看她，慢慢地伸出了手。

admit:2.en: At the edge of the map, Old Helm found a sealed stone door. No key, no handle. Bell pressed her ear to the cold surface and heard a faint hum. 'It wants something from us,' she said. Old Helm had to *admit* he had no idea what that something was.
admit:2.cnHint: 老舵主不得不____，他完全不知道石门想要什么。
admit:2.hook: The hum grew louder, and the door began to glow.
admit:2.line: 'I *admit* I have never seen a door like this one.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the map, Old Helm found a sealed stone door.
sentences.cn: 在地图的尽头，老舵找到了一扇密封的石门。

sentences.en: No key, no handle.
sentences.cn: 没有钥匙，没有把手。

sentences.en: Bell pressed her ear to the cold surface and heard a faint hum.
sentences.cn: 小铃把耳朵贴在冰冷的石面上，听到了一声微弱的嗡鸣。

sentences.en: 'It wants something from us,' she said.
sentences.cn: "它想从我们这儿要什么东西，"她说。

sentences.en: Old Helm had to *admit* he had no idea what that something was.

association:2.en: Deep in the archive tower, Bell unrolled an old scroll. It showed a ring of islands linked by silver lines, with a name printed at the centre: the Star Wanderers *Association*. Our troupe had been following their maps for weeks without knowing it. We were walking in their footsteps the whole time.
association:2.cnHint: 贝尔发现地图中央标注着一个神秘____的名字。
association:2.hook: Someone had circled our current island in fresh red ink.
association:2.line: 'The *association* left these maps for someone to find — perhaps for us.'

sentences.en: Deep in the archive tower, Bell unrolled an old scroll.
sentences.cn: 在档案塔的深处，小铃展开了一卷古老的羊皮纸。

sentences.en: It showed a ring of islands linked by silver lines, with a name printed at the centre: the Star Wanderers *Association*.
Our troupe had been following their maps for weeks without knowing it.
sentences.cn: 我们的剧团几周来一直在跟随他们的地图，却浑然不知。

sentences.en: We were walking in their footsteps the whole time.
sentences.cn: 我们一直走在他们的脚步里。

brand:2.en: Old Helm lifted the lantern over the ancient crate. On its side, burned deep into the wood, was a *brand*: a star inside a circle. Bell had seen that same mark on the very first map fragment we ever collected. The crate had been waiting here for a long, long time.
brand:2.cnHint: 木箱上烙着一个____，与我们最初收集的地图碎片上的记号一模一样。
brand:2.hook: Inside the crate lay a map we had never seen before.
brand:2.line: 'That *brand* — I know it. I have seen it on the oldest fragment.'

sentences.en: Old Helm lifted the lantern over the ancient crate.
sentences.cn: 老舵举起灯笼照向古老的木箱。

sentences.en: On its side, burned deep into the wood, was a *brand*: a star inside a circle.
Bell had seen that same mark on the very first map fragment we ever collected.
sentences.cn: 小铃在我们收集的第一张地图碎片上见过同样的标记。

sentences.en: The crate had been waiting here for a long, long time.
sentences.cn: 这个箱子在这里已经等了很久很久。

deep:2.en: The path led us into a cave below the floating island's root. Moss glowed faintly on the walls. Bell held up her compass, but the needle only spun. We pressed *deep* into the silence, step by careful step, until the cave opened into a vast underground sky full of drifting lights.
deep:2.cnHint: 我们深入洞穴____处，发现了一片漂浮着光点的地下天空。
deep:2.hook: One of the lights drifted close and whispered a single word.
deep:2.line: 'We go *deep* enough, and the island shows us its true heart.'

sentences.en: The path led us into a cave below the floating island's root.
sentences.cn: 小路把我们引入悬浮岛根部下方的一个洞穴。

sentences.en: Moss glowed faintly on the walls.
sentences.cn: 苔藓在墙上微弱地发着光。

sentences.en: Bell held up her compass, but the needle only spun.
sentences.cn: 小铃举起罗盘，但指针只是在打转。

sentences.en: We pressed *deep* into the silence, step by careful step, until the cave opened into a vast underground sky full of drifting lights.

discover:2.en: Bell was cleaning mud from an old sign when she stopped. 'Come look,' she called. We gathered round to *discover* a list of names carved beneath the dirt — every one of them a word we had already collected on our journey. Someone had known our path before we ever took a single step.
discover:2.cnHint: 贝尔清理泥土后，我们____了一份早已预知我们旅程的名单。
discover:2.hook: The last name on the list had not yet been collected.
discover:2.line: 'We *discover* something new, and the map grows one island larger.'

sentences.en: Bell was cleaning mud from an old sign when she stopped.
sentences.cn: 小铃正在清理一块古老的标牌上的泥土时突然停了下来。

sentences.en: 'Come look,' she called.
sentences.cn: "来看看，"她喊道。

sentences.en: We gathered round to *discover* a list of names carved beneath the dirt — every one of them a word we had already collected on our journey.
Someone had known our path before we ever took a single step.
sentences.cn: 有人在我们迈出第一步之前就已经知道了我们的路线。

essential:2.en: Silverfang spread her charts across the bow table and tapped one island firmly. 'This stop is *essential*,' she said. 'Without the word fragment locked there, the northern route stays closed — and winter winds are coming.' Old Helm nodded. For once, rivals agreed. We changed course before the next bell rang.
essential:2.cnHint: 竞争船长强调，拿到那个词语碎片是____的，否则北方航线无法开启。
essential:2.hook: A distant storm confirmed she was right about the timing.
essential:2.line: 'Rest is fine, but this detour is *essential* — trust the charts.'

sentences.en: Silverfang spread her charts across the bow table and tapped one island firmly.
sentences.cn: 银牙在船头的桌子上铺开她的图表，用力拍了一个岛屿。

sentences.en: 'This stop is *essential*,' she said.
'Without the word fragment locked there, the northern route stays closed — and winter winds are coming.'
sentences.cn: "没有锁在那里的词语碎片，北线就会被堵住——冬风快来了。"

sentences.en: Old Helm nodded.
sentences.cn: 老舵点了点头。

sentences.en: For once, rivals agreed.
sentences.cn: 这一次，对手们意见一致。

sentences.en: We changed course before the next bell rang.
sentences.cn: 下一声钟鸣响起之前，我们改变了航向。

fine:2.en: After the stone door finally opened, we stepped into a bright round room. Everything inside was in perfect order: tidy shelves, a clean floor, a warm lamp still burning. 'Someone kept this place *fine* for years,' Old Helm said softly, running a hand along the dust-free shelf. We all felt it — we were not the first.
fine:2.cnHint: 老舵主感叹，这个房间多年来一直被保持得____。
fine:2.hook: A chair by the lamp was still slightly warm.
fine:2.line: 'The room is *fine*, too fine — someone was just here.'

sentences.en: After the stone door finally opened, we stepped into a bright round room.
sentences.cn: 石门终于打开后，我们踏入了一个宽敞的圆形房间。

sentences.en: Everything inside was in perfect order: tidy shelves, a clean floor, a warm lamp still burning.
sentences.cn: 里面的一切都井井有条：整齐的架子、干净的地板、还在燃烧的温暖灯光。

sentences.en: 'Someone kept this place *fine* for years,' Old Helm said softly, running a hand along the dust-free shelf.
We all felt it — we were not the first.
sentences.cn: 我们都感受到了——我们不是第一批到来的人。

largely:2.en: Bell spread the completed map across the floor at last. The journey to the island's edge had been *largely* guided by old star charts we barely trusted. Yet here we stood, exactly where the faded lines had promised. Old Helm laughed — a warm, tired sound. The stars, it turned out, had never lied to us.
largely:2.cnHint: 贝尔感慨，我们的旅程____依靠了几乎不敢相信的古老星图。
largely:2.hook: And the map still had one blank corner left to fill.
largely:2.line: 'Our path was *largely* written in stars before we took it.'

sentences.en: Bell spread the completed map across the floor at last.
sentences.cn: 小铃终于把完整的地图铺在地板上。

sentences.en: The journey to the island's edge had been *largely* guided by old star charts we barely trusted.
Yet here we stood, exactly where the faded lines had promised.
sentences.cn: 然而我们就站在这里，正好在褪色的线条承诺的地方。

sentences.en: Old Helm laughed — a warm, tired sound.
sentences.cn: 老舵笑了——一种温暖而疲惫的笑声。

sentences.en: The stars, it turned out, had never lied to us.
sentences.cn: 原来星星从未对我们撒过谎。

machine:2.en: At the edge of the last island, we found a rusted *machine* half-buried in blue moss. Its gears still turned, slowly, driven by starlight through a cracked glass lens. Old Helm wiped the dust from its face and read aloud the word pressed into its side. The map fragment glowed and a new island rose on the horizon.
machine:2.cnHint: 在最后一座岛的边缘，团长从一台古老的____上读出了新的词语碎片。
machine:2.hook: The gears began turning faster — as if something had been waiting.
machine:2.line: 'This *machine* has been counting the stars since before any of us were born,' Old Helm said softly.

sentences.en: At the edge of the last island, we found a rusted *machine* half-buried in blue moss.
Its gears still turned, slowly, driven by starlight through a cracked glass lens.
sentences.cn: 它的齿轮仍在缓缓转动，由通过裂缝玻璃透镜的星光驱动。

sentences.en: Old Helm wiped the dust from its face and read aloud the word pressed into its side.
sentences.cn: 老舵擦去它表面的灰尘，大声读出压在它侧面的词语。

sentences.en: The map fragment glowed and a new island rose on the horizon.
sentences.cn: 地图碎片发出光芒，一个新的岛屿在地平线上升起。

observe:2.en: Bell called us to the bow before dawn. She pointed to a cluster of lights in the distance — a festival on a far island. 'We must *observe* their lantern-rising,' she said. 'It happens once a year and it is how they say thank you to the sky.' We watched in silence, and the silence felt full.
observe:2.cnHint: 小铃带大家在黎明前聚集，说必须____当地人的灯笼节，那是他们对星空致谢的方式。
observe:2.hook: As the last lantern rose, a word appeared written in light across the clouds.
observe:2.line: 'We *observe* this tradition every time we pass,' Bell said, her eyes bright.

sentences.en: Bell called us to the bow before dawn.
sentences.cn: 黎明前，小铃召唤我们来到船头。

sentences.en: She pointed to a cluster of lights in the distance — a festival on a far island.
sentences.cn: 她指向远处的一群灯光——远方岛屿上的一场节庆。

sentences.en: 'We must *observe* their lantern-rising,' she said.
'It happens once a year and it is how they say thank you to the sky.'
sentences.cn: "这一年只发生一次，这是他们向天空道谢的方式。"

sentences.en: We watched in silence, and the silence felt full.
sentences.cn: 我们沉默地观看，而沉默充满了感受。

fat:2.en: Silverfang traded three star-charts for a round jar of golden *fat* skimmed from cloud-honey bees. The island cook spread it on warm bread and handed a piece to each of us. It tasted like summer and altitude all at once. Old Helm laughed — the first real laugh I had heard from him in days.
fat:2.cnHint: 竞争船长用星图换来了一罐蜂蜜____，岛上的厨师把它抹在面包上招待大家。
fat:2.hook: The cook whispered that the bees only made it when a storm was three days away.
fat:2.line: 'A little cloud-honey *fat* on bread,' Silverfang said, 'and any journey feels shorter.'

sentences.en: Silverfang traded three star-charts for a round jar of golden *fat* skimmed from cloud-honey bees.
The island cook spread it on warm bread and handed a piece to each of us.
sentences.cn: 岛上的厨师把它涂在温热的面包上，给我们每人递了一片。

sentences.en: It tasted like summer and altitude all at once.
sentences.cn: 它尝起来像夏天和高空的滋味混在一起。

sentences.en: Old Helm laughed — the first real laugh I had heard from him in days.
sentences.cn: 老舵笑了——这是我这几天来听到他发出的第一声真正的笑声。

helpful:2.en: I dropped my notebook between two islands and watched it fall into the fog below. Bell said nothing, only tossed a small rope anchor that caught the spine of the book mid-air. She pulled it back and handed it to me with a steady smile. Being *helpful*, I was learning, was simply what she did, as naturally as breathing.
helpful:2.cnHint: 我的笔记本掉落时，小铃不声不响地用绳锚救了它——这就是她____的方式，自然得像呼吸一样。
helpful:2.hook: On the cover, the fog had left behind a word I had never written there.
helpful:2.line: 'Being *helpful* costs nothing and usually opens a door somewhere,' Bell said with a shrug.

sentences.en: I dropped my notebook between two islands and watched it fall into the fog below.
sentences.cn: 我的笔记本从两个岛屿之间掉了下去，我看着它坠入下方的雾气里。

sentences.en: Bell said nothing, only tossed a small rope anchor that caught the spine of the book mid-air.
sentences.cn: 小铃什么也没说，只是甩出一个小绳锚，在空中抓住了书脊。

sentences.en: She pulled it back and handed it to me with a steady smile.
sentences.cn: 她把它拉了回来，用稳定的微笑递给我。

sentences.en: Being *helpful*, I was learning, was simply what she did, as naturally as breathing.

position:2.en: Old Helm unrolled the map on the deck and marked our *position* with a small ink stone. We were further along than I had thought — past the Amber Shelf and nearly level with the Great Drift. 'One more word,' he said quietly, 'and the map fills in the rest.' I leaned over and saw a blank space shaped like a door.
position:2.cnHint: 团长在地图上标出了我们的____，发现只需再找一个词语碎片，地图就会完整。
position:2.hook: The blank space shaped like a door had a tiny handle drawn at its edge.
position:2.line: 'Our *position* is better than it looks,' Old Helm said, pressing the ink stone down firmly.

sentences.en: Old Helm unrolled the map on the deck and marked our *position* with a small ink stone.
We were further along than I had thought — past the Amber Shelf and nearly level with the Great Drift.
sentences.cn: 我们比我想象的走得更远——已经越过了琥珀架，差不多与大漂流齐平了。

sentences.en: 'One more word,' he said quietly, 'and the map fills in the rest.'
sentences.cn: "再来一个词，"他轻声说，"地图就会自己填完。"

sentences.en: I leaned over and saw a blank space shaped like a door.
sentences.cn: 我俯身向下看，看到一个形状像门的空白处。

threat:2.en: A cold wind crossed the deck and the sky turned a deep amber. Bell checked her instruments twice. 'That colour is a *threat*,' she said, 'the islands ahead will shake before morning.' We tied everything down and moved to the lower cabin. By midnight the shaking had passed, and on the wet deck lay a new word, carved into a loose plank.
threat:2.cnHint: 天空变成深琥珀色，小铃说这是一种____，预示着前方岛屿即将震动。
threat:2.hook: The word carved into the plank had not been there when we tied down for the night.
threat:2.line: 'That sky colour is a *threat* — do not let it go unread,' Bell said, tapping her dial.

sentences.en: A cold wind crossed the deck and the sky turned a deep amber.
sentences.cn: 冷风扫过甲板，天色变成了深琥珀色。

sentences.en: Bell checked her instruments twice.
sentences.cn: 小铃检查了两遍仪器。

sentences.en: 'That colour is a *threat*,' she said, 'the islands ahead will shake before morning.'
We tied everything down and moved to the lower cabin.
sentences.cn: 我们把所有东西都系好了，移到下层船舱。

sentences.en: By midnight the shaking had passed, and on the wet deck lay a new word, carved into a loose plank.
sentences.cn: 午夜时分，震动停了，湿漉漉的甲板上出现了一个新词——刻在一块松动的木板上。

trend:2.en: Silverfang spread out his old logbooks and traced a line with his finger. 'The *trend* is clear,' he said. 'Every third island we visit gives a word freely. The others make us earn it.' Old Helm studied the line and nodded slowly. I counted the marks and realised we were due for a free one — the next island glittered ahead like a gift.
trend:2.cnHint: 竞争船长从旧航海日志中发现了一个规律____：每隔两座岛，就有一座岛会主动给出词语碎片。
trend:2.hook: The glittering island was closer than the map said it should be.
trend:2.line: 'Study the *trend* long enough,' Silverfang said, tapping the log, 'and the map starts to teach you.'

sentences.en: Silverfang spread out his old logbooks and traced a line with his finger.
sentences.cn: 银牙摊开了他的老日志，用手指沿着一条线追踪。

sentences.en: 'The *trend* is clear,' he said.
'Every third island we visit gives a word freely.
sentences.cn: 每到第三个岛屿，我们就能免费得到一个词。

sentences.en: The others make us earn it.'
sentences.cn: 其他的岛屿让我们去争取。

sentences.en: Old Helm studied the line and nodded slowly.
sentences.cn: 老舵研究了那条线，缓缓点头。

sentences.en: I counted the marks and realised we were due for a free one — the next island glittered ahead like a gift.
sentences.cn: 我数了数标记，意识到下一个应该是免费的——前方的岛屿闪闪发光，像一份礼物。

ultimately:2.en: We argued for an hour about which path to take — the long way around the Storm Shelf or the short cut through the Pale Gap. Old Helm let us talk. Then he folded his hands and said, '*Ultimately*, the word we need is on the far side either way, so choose the path that teaches you something.' We chose the Gap. It did.
ultimately:2.cnHint: 大家争论了很久走哪条路，团长说____两条路都能到达目的地，不如选一条能让你有所收获的。
ultimately:2.hook: The Pale Gap was narrower than the charts showed — and full of quiet light.
ultimately:2.line: '*Ultimately*, the destination is the same,' Old Helm said. 'The path is the part that differs.'

sentences.en: We argued for an hour about which path to take — the long way around the Storm Shelf or the short cut through the Pale Gap.
sentences.cn: 我们为了选择哪条路线争论了一个小时——是绕风暴架的长路，还是穿过苍白间隙的捷径。

sentences.en: Old Helm let us talk.
sentences.cn: 老舵让我们尽管说。

sentences.en: Then he folded his hands and said, '*Ultimately*, the word we need is on the far side either way, so choose the path that teaches you something.'
We chose the Gap.
sentences.cn: 我们选了间隙。

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.cn: 值得。

australia:2.en: Bell spread the old map across the deck and pointed to a blank patch shaped like a sleeping animal. 'This island has no name yet,' she said. Old Helm smiled and pressed the word *australia* onto the patch. The blank space shimmered, and a warm golden coast rose slowly out of the clouds below us.
australia:2.cnHint: 小铃在地图上发现一片空白区域，老舵将一个____贴上去后，一片金色海岸从云层中升起。
australia:2.hook: But the coast kept rising, and something enormous moved beneath it.
australia:2.line: 'Old Helm, the word *australia* just filled the last blank on the southern half of the map!'

sentences.en: Bell spread the old map across the deck and pointed to a blank patch shaped like a sleeping animal.
sentences.cn: 小铃把老地图铺在甲板上，指向一块形似沉睡动物的空白区域。

sentences.en: 'This island has no name yet,' she said.
sentences.cn: 这个岛还没有名字，她说。

sentences.en: Old Helm smiled and pressed the word *australia* onto the patch.
The blank space shimmered, and a warm golden coast rose slowly out of the clouds below us.
sentences.cn: 空白处闪烁起来，一片温暖的金色海岸缓缓从我们下方的云层里升起。

authority:2.en: The gate to the Crystal Shelf was locked, and a carved stone face above it demanded proof of passage. Old Helm stepped forward without hesitation. He held up our troupe seal and spoke in a calm, steady voice. The gate recognised his *authority* and ground open, letting starlight pour through the gap.
authority:2.cnHint: 通往水晶台地的大门紧闭，老舵凭借自己的____让石门缓缓开启。
authority:2.hook: Beyond the gate, a second door waited — and it had no keyhole at all.
authority:2.line: 'My *authority* as troupe leader should be enough to open this gate.'

sentences.en: The gate to the Crystal Shelf was locked, and a carved stone face above it demanded proof of passage.
sentences.cn: 通往水晶架的大门上了锁，门上方一张雕刻的石脸要求通行证。

sentences.en: Old Helm stepped forward without hesitation.
sentences.cn: 老舵毫不犹豫地走上前。

sentences.en: He held up our troupe seal and spoke in a calm, steady voice.
sentences.cn: 他举起我们的剧团印章，用平静沉稳的声音说了什么。

sentences.en: The gate recognised his *authority* and ground open, letting starlight pour through the gap.

confident:2.en: I had never read a sky-chart before, but Bell handed me hers and nodded. My hands were shaking. I traced the star path slowly, then called out the heading. Bell smiled. 'You sound *confident*,' she said, and I realised I actually was — the stars had answered me back, clear as a bell.
confident:2.cnHint: 小铃把星图交给我，我第一次独立辨认航向，竟发现自己出乎意料地____。
confident:2.hook: Then one star on the chart blinked, and the heading changed.
confident:2.line: 'You look *confident* up there — keep your eyes on the twin stars.'

sentences.en: I had never read a sky-chart before, but Bell handed me hers and nodded.
sentences.cn: 我从来没读过天空图，但小铃递给了我一份，点了点头。

sentences.en: My hands were shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手在发抖。

sentences.en: I traced the star path slowly, then called out the heading.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓沿着星图追踪，然后喊出了航向。

sentences.en: Bell smiled.
sentences.cn: 小铃笑了。

sentences.en: 'You sound *confident*,' she said, and I realised I actually was — the stars had answered me back, clear as a bell.

crowd:2.en: We drifted into Lantern Reef just before the festival began. A *crowd* of islanders filled the stone square, each one holding a jar of captured starlight. Old Helm waded in, laughing, and traded our newest word for three warm jars. We lifted them high and the whole square blazed like a second sky.
crowd:2.cnHint: 我们抵达灯笼礁时，广场上____满了手持星光罐的岛民，老舵用新词换来了三个光罐。
crowd:2.hook: One jar in my hands buzzed softly, as though something inside it was still awake.
crowd:2.line: 'Bell, look at this *crowd* — I have never seen so many lanterns in one place!'

sentences.en: We drifted into Lantern Reef just before the festival began.
sentences.cn: 我们在节庆开始前漂进了灯塔礁。

sentences.en: A *crowd* of islanders filled the stone square, each one holding a jar of captured starlight.
Old Helm waded in, laughing, and traded our newest word for three warm jars.
sentences.cn: 老舵趟了进去，笑着大喊，用我们最新的词换了三罐温热的罐子。

sentences.en: We lifted them high and the whole square blazed like a second sky.
sentences.cn: 我们举起它们，整个广场都像第二片天空一样闪闪发光。

highly:2.en: Old Helm pulled a small sealed note from the message tree at Windpost Island. He read it twice, eyebrows rising. 'The Council speaks *highly* of our collection,' he said quietly, folding it back. Bell and I exchanged a grin. Then he turned the note over — there was a second message on the back, written in red ink.
highly:2.cnHint: 老舵在风柱岛的留言树上取到一封信，信中对我们的____评价极高，但背面还有一行红字。
highly:2.hook: The red ink was still wet.
highly:2.line: 'They speak *highly* of every troupe that reaches the Windpost — but few read the back.'

sentences.en: Old Helm pulled a small sealed note from the message tree at Windpost Island.
sentences.cn: 老舵从风岗岛的信树上拉下一张小的密封纸条。

sentences.en: He read it twice, eyebrows rising.
sentences.cn: 他读了两遍，眉毛抬了起来。

sentences.en: 'The Council speaks *highly* of our collection,' he said quietly, folding it back.
Bell and I exchanged a grin.
sentences.cn: 小铃和我交换了一个眼神。

sentences.en: Then he turned the note over — there was a second message on the back, written in red ink.
sentences.cn: 然后他翻过纸条——背面用红墨水写着第二条信息。

occur:2.en: We were crossing the Pale Drift when Bell suddenly grabbed my sleeve. 'Did it *occur* to you that we have been here before?' she whispered. I looked around — the same bent cloud, the same blue rock. Our map had looped. Old Helm was already tying a new word to the compass rose, and the drift slowly unwound around us.
occur:2.cnHint: 渡越苍白漂流带时，小铃突然意识到一件____过她的事：我们似乎已经绕回原路了。
occur:2.hook: The compass rose spun once more, and pointed somewhere the map did not show.
occur:2.line: 'Bell, did it *occur* to you that the drift moves when we stop reading the stars?'

sentences.en: We were crossing the Pale Drift when Bell suddenly grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 我们穿过苍白漂流时，小铃突然抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Did it *occur* to you that we have been here before?' she whispered.
I looked around — the same bent cloud, the same blue rock.
sentences.cn: 我环顾四周——同样的弯曲云朵，同样的蓝色岩石。

sentences.en: Our map had looped.
sentences.cn: 我们的地图绕了个圈。

sentences.en: Old Helm was already tying a new word to the compass rose, and the drift slowly unwound around us.
sentences.cn: 老舵已经在系一个新词到罗盘玫瑰上，漂流缓缓在我们周围展开了。

regularly:2.en: On Echo Shelf, I found a hollow post carved with tiny marks. Bell explained that passing troupe members left words here *regularly*, each one feeding the island's memory. I pressed our newest word into the lowest empty slot. A low hum rose from the ground, and a hidden staircase unfolded toward the next island above.
regularly:2.cnHint: 在回响台地，过往船员____在空心柱上刻字，我刻下新词后，一段隐藏的阶梯向上展开。
regularly:2.hook: The staircase kept unfolding, past the clouds, past the stars, into total darkness.
regularly:2.line: 'Troupe members *regularly* leave a word here — it keeps the shelf from going quiet.'

sentences.en: On Echo Shelf, I found a hollow post carved with tiny marks.
sentences.cn: 在回声架上，我找到了一根雕刻满细小标记的空心柱子。

sentences.en: Bell explained that passing troupe members left words here *regularly*, each one feeding the island's memory.
I pressed our newest word into the lowest empty slot.
sentences.cn: 我把我们最新的词按进了最低的空槽。

sentences.en: A low hum rose from the ground, and a hidden staircase unfolded toward the next island above.
sentences.cn: 地面升起了一声低鸣，一道隐藏的楼梯向上方的下一个岛屿展开。

responsible:2.en: A storm had torn a rope bridge linking two small islands. Old Helm looked at me. 'You tied the last knot,' he said, not unkindly. 'That makes you *responsible* for fixing it.' I felt the weight of it, picked up the rope, and worked until the bridge was stronger than before. He crossed first, testing every step, then gave a slow nod.
responsible:2.cnHint: 吊桥断裂，老舵告诉我，因为是我最后打的结，所以我需____修好它。
responsible:2.hook: Halfway across, Old Helm paused and looked down into the clouds below.
responsible:2.line: 'You tied the last knot, so you are *responsible* — and I think you already know that.'

sentences.en: A storm had torn a rope bridge linking two small islands.
sentences.cn: 一场风暴撕裂了连接两个小岛的绳桥。

sentences.en: Old Helm looked at me.
sentences.cn: 老舵看着我。

sentences.en: 'You tied the last knot,' he said, not unkindly.
sentences.cn: 你打了最后一个结，他说，不带恶意。

sentences.en: 'That makes you *responsible* for fixing it.'
I felt the weight of it, picked up the rope, and worked until the bridge was stronger than before.
sentences.cn: 我感到了那份沉甸甸的责任，拿起绳子，一直干到桥比之前还要坚固。

sentences.en: He crossed first, testing every step, then gave a slow nod.
sentences.cn: 他先过去，测试着每一步，然后缓缓点了点头。

digital:2.en: At the edge of the map, Bell pressed her palm against a stone pillar. Strange marks lit up beneath her fingers — not carved, but glowing, shifting, alive. 'These are *digital* signals,' she whispered, 'patterns made of light and number, not ink.' Old Helm leaned close, eyes wide with wonder.
digital:2.cnHint: 小铃在石柱上发现了发光的____信号，老舵长目瞪口呆。
digital:2.hook: The pillar hummed, and a hidden door began to open.
digital:2.line: 'These *digital* patterns — they are a message, not a decoration.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the map, Bell pressed her palm against a stone pillar.
sentences.cn: 在地图边缘，小铃把手掌压在一根石柱上。

sentences.en: Strange marks lit up beneath her fingers — not carved, but glowing, shifting, alive.
sentences.cn: 奇怪的标记在她的手指下亮了起来——不是刻的，而是发光的、流动的、活的。

sentences.en: 'These are *digital* signals,' she whispered, 'patterns made of light and number, not ink.'
Old Helm leaned close, eyes wide with wonder.
sentences.cn: 老舵靠近，眼睛睁得很大，满是惊奇。

sale:2.en: On a mossy ledge near the island's edge, a small wooden stall stood alone. Jars of glowing seeds, dried star-flowers, and tiny compass charms covered every shelf. A painted sign read: 'Final *sale* — last stop before the beyond.' Old Helm smiled and reached for his coin pouch.
sale:2.cnHint: 地图边缘有一个摊位正在____，老舵长掏出了钱袋。
sale:2.hook: The seller's eyes gleamed — she already knew what we needed.
sale:2.line: 'Everything on this shelf is on *sale*, but only until the stars shift.'

sentences.en: On a mossy ledge near the island's edge, a small wooden stall stood alone.
sentences.cn: 青苔覆盖的小岛边缘，一间简陋的木制小棚孤零零地站着。

sentences.en: Jars of glowing seeds, dried star-flowers, and tiny compass charms covered every shelf.
sentences.cn: 架子上堆满了发光的种子、干枯的星花和小小的指南针护符。

sentences.en: A painted sign read: 'Final *sale* — last stop before the beyond.'
Old Helm smiled and reached for his coin pouch.
sentences.cn: 老舵微笑着伸手去摸他的钱袋。

contact:2.en: Bell climbed the tallest crystal spire and held up a small mirror, flashing light in long and short bursts. She was trying to *contact* a distant island spotted earlier through the telescope. Minutes passed. Then, from far across the cloud-sea, a mirror flashed back — slow, steady, deliberate.
contact:2.cnHint: 小铃用镜子闪光，试图____远处岛屿上的人。
contact:2.hook: The reply spelled out two words we did not expect.
contact:2.line: 'We must *contact* them before the cloud-bridge dissolves.'

sentences.en: Bell climbed the tallest crystal spire and held up a small mirror, flashing light in long and short bursts.
sentences.cn: 小铃爬上最高的水晶尖塔，举起一面小镜子，用长短不一的闪光发出信号。

sentences.en: She was trying to *contact* a distant island spotted earlier through the telescope.
Minutes passed.
sentences.cn: 几分钟过去了。

sentences.en: Then, from far across the cloud-sea, a mirror flashed back — slow, steady, deliberate.
sentences.cn: 然后，从遥远的云海那边，一面镜子闪闪发光地闪了回来——缓慢、稳定、坚定有力。

failure:2.en: Old Helm stared at the torn corner of the map, jaw tight. We had followed every clue, crossed three sky-currents, and still arrived at empty rock. 'This is not a *failure*,' he said quietly, picking up a feather left on the stone, 'it is the map asking us to look harder.'
failure:2.cnHint: 空手而归，但老舵长说这次的____另有深意。
failure:2.hook: The feather trembled, pointing back the way we had come.
failure:2.line: 'A *failure* to find the word only means the word found us first.'

sentences.en: Old Helm stared at the torn corner of the map, jaw tight.
sentences.cn: 老舵盯着地图撕破的角落，下巴紧绷。

sentences.en: We had followed every clue, crossed three sky-currents, and still arrived at empty rock.
sentences.cn: 我们追循了每一条线索，穿过三股气流，最后来到的却是一块空荡荡的岩石。

sentences.en: 'This is not a *failure*,' he said quietly, picking up a feather left on the stone, 'it is the map asking us to look harder.'

bird:2.en: A copper-coloured *bird* landed on the ship's railing just as we crossed into uncharted sky. It carried a tiny rolled note tied to its leg with blue thread. Bell reached out carefully and the creature stood perfectly still, watching us with one bright, knowing eye.
bird:2.cnHint: 一只____停在船栏上，腿上绑着一张纸条。
bird:2.hook: The note bore no name — only a single strange symbol.
bird:2.line: 'That *bird* has crossed more sky than any of us ever have.'

sentences.en: A copper-coloured *bird* landed on the ship's railing just as we crossed into uncharted sky.
It carried a tiny rolled note tied to its leg with blue thread.
sentences.cn: 它的腿上用蓝线系着一张卷起来的小纸条。

sentences.en: Bell reached out carefully and the creature stood perfectly still, watching us with one bright, knowing eye.
sentences.cn: 小铃小心翼翼地伸出手，那生物完全静止了，用一只明亮、聪慧的眼睛注视着我们。

official:2.en: A carved seal on the cavern wall bore a sun and three interlocked rings — the mark of an *official* of the old Sky Council, Bell said, brushing away dust. Below the seal was a locked iron box. Whoever placed it here had the authority to shape whole islands.
official:2.cnHint: 洞壁上的印章属于某位天空议会____，铁箱就藏在印章之下。
official:2.hook: Old Helm already had a key that matched the lock's shape.
official:2.line: 'Only an *official* of the Sky Council could leave a mark this deep in stone.'

sentences.en: A carved seal on the cavern wall bore a sun and three interlocked rings — the mark of an *official* of the old Sky Council, Bell said, brushing away dust.
Below the seal was a locked iron box.
sentences.cn: 铁箱子下面被锁上了。

sentences.en: Whoever placed it here had the authority to shape whole islands.
sentences.cn: 放在这里的人有改变整个岛屿的权力。

confidence:2.en: Silverfang's ship pulled alongside ours at the misty rim of the known world. She stood at the bow with easy *confidence*, arms folded, grinning at us across the gap. 'Scared of the edge?' she called. Old Helm straightened up, refusing to let her see any doubt in him.
confidence:2.cnHint: 竞争船长满怀____站在船头，向我们发出挑战。
confidence:2.hook: Beyond her ship, the mist parted to reveal something enormous.
confidence:2.line: 'You need *confidence* to sail past the edge — do you have it?'

sentences.en: Silverfang's ship pulled alongside ours at the misty rim of the known world.
sentences.cn: 银牙的船在已知世界的雾蒙蒙的边缘靠上了我们的船。

sentences.en: She stood at the bow with easy *confidence*, arms folded, grinning at us across the gap.
'Scared of the edge?' she called.
sentences.cn: "害怕边界吗？"她喊道。

sentences.en: Old Helm straightened up, refusing to let her see any doubt in him.
sentences.cn: 老舵挺起身子，拒绝让她看到他心中的任何怀疑。

display:2.en: Inside the hollow island, walls of pale crystal began to *display* moving images — old voyages, lost routes, skies we had never seen. Bell pressed her notebook to her chest and spun slowly, trying to take it all in. The images flickered like memories the island had kept for centuries.
display:2.cnHint: 空心岛的水晶墙壁开始____古老的航行影像，小铃惊叹不已。
display:2.hook: One image showed our own ship — arriving here long before we were born.
display:2.line: 'The walls *display* the past, but I think they are warning us too.'

sentences.en: Inside the hollow island, walls of pale crystal began to *display* moving images — old voyages, lost routes, skies we had never seen.
Bell pressed her notebook to her chest and spun slowly, trying to take it all in.
sentences.cn: 小铃把笔记本紧贴在胸口，缓缓转身，试图把这一切都记在心里。

sentences.en: The images flickered like memories the island had kept for centuries.
sentences.cn: 这些图像闪烁着，就像小岛几个世纪以来保存的记忆。

experiment:2.en: Deep inside a hollow island, we found a stone table covered in symbols. Old Helm traced each one carefully. 'Someone ran an *experiment* here,' he said, 'testing whether wind and light could grow seeds without soil.' Small glass jars still held tiny green shoots, reaching upward in the dark.
experiment:2.cnHint: 在一座空心岛的深处，团长发现有人曾在此进行____，玻璃罐里的嫩芽至今仍在生长。
experiment:2.hook: One jar had already cracked open from the inside.
experiment:2.line: 'This *experiment* is still running — someone meant to come back.'

sentences.en: Deep inside a hollow island, we found a stone table covered in symbols.
sentences.cn: 在空心岛的深处，我们发现了一张用符号覆盖的石桌。

sentences.en: Old Helm traced each one carefully.
sentences.cn: 老舵仔细地追踪了每一个符号。

sentences.en: 'Someone ran an *experiment* here,' he said, 'testing whether wind and light could grow seeds without soil.'
Small glass jars still held tiny green shoots, reaching upward in the dark.
sentences.cn: 小玻璃罐里还装着小小的绿芽，在黑暗中向上伸展。

nature:2.en: Bell led us onto a wide, flat island where no buildings stood. Soft moss covered everything, and strange birds with silver wings landed near our feet without fear. 'This is the *nature* of this place,' Bell said quietly, 'it has never been touched by any troupe before us.' We all held our breath.
nature:2.cnHint: 贝尔带我们走上一座无人踏足的岛，感受这片土地最原始的____。
nature:2.hook: Then something large moved beneath the moss.
nature:2.line: 'The *nature* of this island is to stay wild — we should be careful.'

sentences.en: Bell led us onto a wide, flat island where no buildings stood.
sentences.cn: 小铃带我们走上了一个宽阔平坦的岛屿，上面没有建筑。

sentences.en: Soft moss covered everything, and strange birds with silver wings landed near our feet without fear.
sentences.cn: 柔软的青苔覆盖了一切，银色翅膀的奇异鸟类毫无畏惧地降落在我们脚边。

sentences.en: 'This is the *nature* of this place,' Bell said quietly, 'it has never been touched by any troupe before us.'
We all held our breath.
sentences.cn: 我们都屏住了呼吸。

status:2.en: At the edge of a bridge between two islands, a stone board listed every troupe that had ever passed. Old Helm found our name near the bottom. 'Low *status*,' Silverfang said with a grin, 'for now.' Old Helm just smiled and pointed at all the blank space still left above the top name.
status:2.cnHint: 在一块记录各路船队____的石碑前，竞争船长看到了自己的位置。
status:2.hook: The top name had been scratched out by someone in a hurry.
status:2.line: 'Our *status* on that board will look very different by the end.'

sentences.en: At the edge of a bridge between two islands, a stone board listed every troupe that had ever passed.
sentences.cn: 在两个岛屿之间的桥边，一块石板列出了曾经经过的每一个剧团。

sentences.en: Old Helm found our name near the bottom.
sentences.cn: 老舵在底部附近找到了我们的名字。

sentences.en: 'Low *status*,' Silverfang said with a grin, 'for now.'
Old Helm just smiled and pointed at all the blank space still left above the top name.
sentences.cn: 老舵只是笑着指向最顶部名字上面还留着的所有空白处。

accident:2.en: I knocked a small brass compass off the shelf by *accident*, and it shattered on the floor. Inside, where the needle should have been, there was a folded piece of cloth. Bell unfolded it slowly. It was a map of an island none of us had ever seen, with a single red mark at its centre.
accident:2.cnHint: 我不小心打碎了一个黄铜罗盘，没想到这个____让我们发现了一张神秘地图。
accident:2.hook: The red mark was still slightly warm to the touch.
accident:2.line: 'That *accident* might be the luckiest thing that ever happened to us.'

sentences.en: I knocked a small brass compass off the shelf by *accident*, and it shattered on the floor.
Inside, where the needle should have been, there was a folded piece of cloth.
sentences.cn: 在针应该在的地方，有一块折叠起来的布。

sentences.en: Bell unfolded it slowly.
sentences.cn: 小铃慢慢地展开了它。

sentences.en: It was a map of an island none of us had ever seen, with a single red mark at its centre.
sentences.cn: 那是一张我们从未见过的岛屿地图，中心有一个红色标记。

active:2.en: The island shook every few minutes. Old Helm checked a small notebook and nodded. 'The heat vents below are still *active*,' he said, 'they push warm air up through the rock and keep the whole island floating.' We felt the gentle vibration in our boots and understood, for the first time, how alive the sky truly was.
active:2.cnHint: 老舵长告诉我们，岛下方的热气孔仍然____，这正是岛屿漂浮的秘密。
active:2.hook: The next tremor lasted twice as long as the last.
active:2.line: 'Stay alert — those vents are *active* and the ground can shift fast.'

sentences.en: The island shook every few minutes.
sentences.cn: 小岛每隔几分钟就震动一次。

sentences.en: Old Helm checked a small notebook and nodded.
sentences.cn: 老舵查看了一本小笔记本，点了点头。

sentences.en: 'The heat vents below are still *active*,' he said, 'they push warm air up through the rock and keep the whole island floating.'
We felt the gentle vibration in our boots and understood, for the first time, how alive the sky truly was.
sentences.cn: 我们感到靴子里传来温和的震动，第一次明白了天空是多么生机勃勃。

feed:2.en: At the far rim of the island, Bell found a wide stone bowl filled with seeds. Every morning, she told us, the wind currents carried small sky-birds here to eat. She began to *feed* them by hand, one by one, and each bird left behind a single bright feather that glowed faintly in the dark.
feed:2.cnHint: 贝尔在岛边发现了一个石碗，她开始____前来觅食的空中小鸟，每只鸟都留下了一片发光的羽毛。
feed:2.hook: The last feather spelled out a word none of us could read.
feed:2.line: 'If you *feed* them gently, they trust you — and trust opens every door.'

sentences.en: At the far rim of the island, Bell found a wide stone bowl filled with seeds.
sentences.cn: 小铃在岛屿的远端找到了一个装满种子的宽石碗。

sentences.en: Every morning, she told us, the wind currents carried small sky-birds here to eat.
sentences.cn: 她告诉我们，每天早上风流都会把小天鸟吹到这里来觅食。

sentences.en: She began to *feed* them by hand, one by one, and each bird left behind a single bright feather that glowed faintly in the dark.

principle:2.en: Old Helm spread three maps on the ground and stared at them for a long time. 'There is one *principle* behind all of them,' he said at last. 'Every path curves toward the brightest star, never away.' Bell marked the pattern in red ink, and suddenly the blank spaces on each map began to make perfect sense.
principle:2.cnHint: 老舵长研究三张地图后，发现了隐藏其中的同一条____，指引着每一条路的走向。
principle:2.hook: But the brightest star had shifted slightly since last night.
principle:2.line: 'Hold to this *principle* and the map will never truly let you down.'

sentences.en: Old Helm spread three maps on the ground and stared at them for a long time.
sentences.cn: 老舵在地上铺开三张地图，盯着它们看了很久。

sentences.en: 'There is one *principle* behind all of them,' he said at last.
'Every path curves toward the brightest star, never away.'
sentences.cn: 每条路都弯向最亮的星星，从不偏离。

sentences.en: Bell marked the pattern in red ink, and suddenly the blank spaces on each map began to make perfect sense.
sentences.cn: 小铃用红墨水标出了这个规律，突然之间每张地图上的空白处都清晰可见了。

article:2.en: Inside a sealed tin box, we found a single folded page — an *article* written by a traveller who had reached the very edge of the known sky. The words were faded, but one line was clear: 'Beyond the last island, the stars are close enough to touch.' Old Helm folded it and put it in his coat.
article:2.cnHint: 我们在密封的铁盒里发现了一篇旅行者写下的____，记录了他抵达已知天空尽头时的所见。
article:2.hook: The date on the page was only three weeks ago.
article:2.line: 'This *article* is proof — someone reached that place and came back alive.'

sentences.en: Inside a sealed tin box, we found a single folded page — an *article* written by a traveller who had reached the very edge of the known sky.
The words were faded, but one line was clear: 'Beyond the last island, the stars are close enough to touch.'
sentences.cn: 字迹已经褪了，但有一行字清晰可辨：「越过最后的岛屿，星星近得可以触手可及。」

sentences.en: Old Helm folded it and put it in his coat.
sentences.cn: 老舵把它折起来放进外套里。

awareness:2.en: At the edge of the map, a stone pillar stood alone. Old Helm pressed his hand against it and closed his eyes. Slowly, an *awareness* of something vast and old moved through him — like the island itself was thinking. He opened his eyes, breath short.
awareness:2.cnHint: 老舵主触碰石柱，突然对岛屿的古老力量产生了____。
awareness:2.hook: The pillar began to hum, and none of us could move.
awareness:2.line: 'A quiet *awareness* crept over me — this island is alive.'

sentences.en: At the edge of the map, a stone pillar stood alone.
sentences.cn: 在地图的边缘，一根石柱孤独地矗立着。

sentences.en: Old Helm pressed his hand against it and closed his eyes.
sentences.cn: 老舵把手贴在上面，闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: Slowly, an *awareness* of something vast and old moved through him — like the island itself was thinking.
He opened his eyes, breath short.
sentences.cn: 他睁开眼睛，呼吸急促。

introduce:2.en: Bell unrolled a pale scroll she had found tucked inside the hollow of a driftwood post. Strange symbols filled the top half. Below them, a single sentence in plain English read: 'Let this map *introduce* you to the place where the last word sleeps.' She looked up at us.
introduce:2.cnHint: 小铃展开卷轴，文字将众人____到那个沉睡着最后词语的地方。
introduce:2.hook: Below the sentence, a second scroll was hidden, still sealed.
introduce:2.line: 'These words *introduce* us to a world no traveller has named yet.'

sentences.en: Bell unrolled a pale scroll she had found tucked inside the hollow of a driftwood post.
sentences.cn: 小铃展开了一卷淡色的纸卷，那是她从一根空心的浮木柱里找到的。

sentences.en: Strange symbols filled the top half.
sentences.cn: 奇怪的符号填满了上半部分。

sentences.en: Below them, a single sentence in plain English read: 'Let this map *introduce* you to the place where the last word sleeps.'
She looked up at us.
sentences.cn: 她抬头看着我们。

expense:2.en: Old Helm spread the recovered fragments across the deck. The journey here had come at great *expense* — three weeks of supplies gone, two torn sails, and Bell's favourite compass lost to the wind. Yet the fragments together showed a shape none of us expected: a door.
expense:2.cnHint: 老舵主展开碎片，这趟旅途付出了巨大的____，却意外拼出了一扇门的轮廓。
expense:2.hook: The door-shaped map pulsed once, then went perfectly still.
expense:2.line: 'No *expense* is too great when the last word is this close.'

sentences.en: Old Helm spread the recovered fragments across the deck.
sentences.cn: 老舵把找回的碎片铺在甲板上。

sentences.en: The journey here had come at great *expense* — three weeks of supplies gone, two torn sails, and Bell's favourite compass lost to the wind.
Yet the fragments together showed a shape none of us expected: a door.
sentences.cn: 然而这些碎片合在一起却显示出了一个形状，是我们都没想到的：一扇门。

toward:2.en: A paper bird drifted down from above the clouds and landed on my open palm. Its wings were covered in tiny ink marks. When I tilted it, every mark shifted *toward* the same corner of the sky — pointing, as if the bird itself knew the way.
toward:2.cnHint: 一只纸鸟落在叙述者手中，所有墨迹都朝____同一方向偏转。
toward:2.hook: Far off in that corner, a single light blinked twice.
toward:2.line: 'Every mark turns *toward* the north edge — that is where we sail.'

sentences.en: A paper bird drifted down from above the clouds and landed on my open palm.
sentences.cn: 一只纸鸟从云层上方飘落下来，落在了我张开的手心。

sentences.en: Its wings were covered in tiny ink marks.
sentences.cn: 它的翅膀上覆盖着细小的墨迹。

sentences.en: When I tilted it, every mark shifted *toward* the same corner of the sky — pointing, as if the bird itself knew the way.

track:2.en: Silverfang crouched on the mossy rim of a lower island and studied the ground carefully. A thin groove cut across the stone, perfectly straight. 'A *track*,' she said quietly, running one finger along it. 'Something heavy rolled over this — and not long ago.' Dust still rose from the groove.
track:2.cnHint: 银牙队长发现石面上有一道____，判断有重物不久前经过。
track:2.hook: The groove led straight to the edge — and then dropped into nothing.
track:2.line: 'This *track* is fresh — whatever made it is still close by.'

sentences.en: Silverfang crouched on the mossy rim of a lower island and studied the ground carefully.
sentences.cn: 银牙蹲在一个低一些的岛屿长满苔藓的边缘，仔细研究着地面。

sentences.en: A thin groove cut across the stone, perfectly straight.
sentences.cn: 一条细细的沟痕切过石头，笔直得很。

sentences.en: 'A *track*,' she said quietly, running one finger along it.
'Something heavy rolled over this — and not long ago.'
sentences.cn: 「有什么沉重的东西在这上面滚过——而且不久前。」

sentences.en: Dust still rose from the groove.
sentences.cn: 沟痕里还飘起灰尘。

afford:2.en: The word-fragment was locked inside a glass sphere the size of my fist. Old Helm studied it for a long moment. 'We cannot *afford* to leave this behind,' he said, wrapping it in his coat. Even a single lost fragment meant a blank on the map and a door that would never open.
afford:2.cnHint: 老舵主说他们____不能把这个词语碎片留下，否则地图将永远残缺。
afford:2.hook: As he wrapped it, the sphere flashed gold once and went dark.
afford:2.line: 'We cannot *afford* to lose even one piece of this map.'

sentences.en: The word-fragment was locked inside a glass sphere the size of my fist.
sentences.cn: 那个词的碎片被锁在一个拳头大小的玻璃球里。

sentences.en: Old Helm studied it for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 老舵研究了它很久。

sentences.en: 'We cannot *afford* to leave this behind,' he said, wrapping it in his coat.
Even a single lost fragment meant a blank on the map and a door that would never open.
sentences.cn: 就算只失去一个碎片，地图上就会出现空白，那扇门也永远打不开。

feature:2.en: Bell sketched the landscape into her notebook with quick, sure strokes. The most striking *feature* of this island was a ridge of silver rock that curved around the centre like a cupped hand. She tapped the sketch. 'That curve,' she said, 'matches a symbol on the oldest fragment we carry.'
feature:2.cnHint: 小铃发现这座岛最突出的____与最古老碎片上的符号完全吻合。
feature:2.hook: She turned the fragment over and found fresh ink on the back.
feature:2.line: 'The curved ridge is the key *feature* — it is drawn on our oldest map.'

sentences.en: Bell sketched the landscape into her notebook with quick, sure strokes.
sentences.cn: 小铃用快速有力的笔触把风景素描在笔记本里。

sentences.en: The most striking *feature* of this island was a ridge of silver rock that curved around the centre like a cupped hand.
She tapped the sketch.
sentences.cn: 她拍了拍素描。

sentences.en: 'That curve,' she said, 'matches a symbol on the oldest fragment we carry.'
sentences.cn: 「那条曲线，」她说，「和我们携带的最古老的碎片上的符号是一样的。」

innovative:2.en: Tucked into a crevice near the island's rim, we found a small machine made of brass rings and spinning glass discs. It was unlike anything Old Helm had seen in forty years of travel. 'Whoever built this was truly *innovative*,' he said softly. The machine was sorting words — automatically, by shape.
innovative:2.cnHint: 众人发现一台会自动分类词语的奇妙装置，老舵主称其制造者十分____。
innovative:2.hook: One disc stopped spinning and pointed directly at me.
innovative:2.line: 'Whoever left this was *innovative* — it still works after all these years.'

sentences.en: Tucked into a crevice near the island's rim, we found a small machine made of brass rings and spinning glass discs.
sentences.cn: 在岛屿边缘附近的一条裂缝里，我们找到了一台由黄铜环和旋转玻璃圆盘组成的小机器。

sentences.en: It was unlike anything Old Helm had seen in forty years of travel.
sentences.cn: 在老舵四十年的旅行中从未见过这样的东西。

sentences.en: 'Whoever built this was truly *innovative*,' he said softly.
The machine was sorting words — automatically, by shape.
sentences.cn: 那台机器在自动分类单词——按形状分类。

slightly:2.en: The old bottle had been sealed for years. When Bell *slightly* tilted it, a rolled-up note slid out and landed in my palm. The paper was thin, covered in tiny drawings of islands we had never seen. Old Helm leaned close, eyes wide, and whispered that this was no ordinary map.
slightly:2.cnHint: 小铃把旧瓶子____倾斜，一张藏有未知岛屿地图的纸条滑了出来。
